# DataDashOS

> The KPI-first operating system for your business. DataDashOS defines the KPIs your business should run on, tracks them, helps you hit them, and adapts them as you grow.

Canonical site: https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/
Contact: hello@datadashos.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/): Product overview, KPI demo, waitlist
- [How it works](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/how-it-works.html): Define, Track, Manage, Adapt
- [About](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/about.html): Operator story and beliefs
- [FAQ](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/faq.html): Common questions
- [Privacy](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/privacy.html): Draft privacy policy
- [Terms](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/terms.html): Draft terms of service
